input.prompt: Edit this exact watercolor painting. Keep everything outside the large pale oval in the centre exactly as it is: the same composition, plants, garlands, colours, paper texture and soft linework. Paint inside the oval, so the oval disappears and the picture becomes one continuous scene: the two of them sitting across a small round cafe table on the hillside terrace above the sea, talking and smiling over cups of coffee, the turquoise sea and green hills behind them; he wears a checked shirt and she wears a cream top. The two people are a young Indian couple drawn as delicate storybook watercolor illustrations in the same soft style and palette as the rest of the painting (illustrated, not photographic): he has short black hair, a neat short beard and glasses; she has long black hair in a braid. Simple, gentle faces. No text, no letters, no numbers, no lamps, no candles, no diyas, no flames, no fire.
